cat << 'EOF' > solution.sh
#!/bin/bash
# Find sum of integers in log files where server ID is prime and file created within last 7 days

is_prime() {
    local n=$1
    if [ "$n" -lt 2 ]; then
        return 1
    fi
    if [ "$n" -lt 4 ]; then
        return 0
    fi
    if [ $((n % 2)) -eq 0 ]; then
        return 1
    fi
    local i=3
    while [ $((i * i)) -le "$n" ]; do
        if [ $((n % i)) -eq 0 ]; then
            return 1
        fi
        i=$((i + 2))
    done
    return 0
}

today=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
sum=0

for f in log_files/*.txt; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    fname=$(basename "$f")

    # Extract server ID
    server_id=$(echo "$fname" | sed -E 's/^log_server_([0-9]+)_[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\.txt$/\1/')

    # Extract date
    file_date=$(echo "$fname" | sed -E 's/^log_server_[0-9]+_([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2})\.txt$/\1/')

    # Check prime
    if ! is_prime "$server_id"; then
        continue
    fi

    # Check within last 7 days
    file_epoch=$(date -d "$file_date" +%s)
    today_epoch=$(date -d "$today" +%s)
    diff_days=$(( (today_epoch - file_epoch) / 86400 ))

    if [ "$diff_days" -ge 0 ] && [ "$diff_days" -le 7 ]; then
        # Sum integers in file
        while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
            if [[ "$line" =~ ^-?[0-9]+$ ]]; then
                sum=$((sum + line))
            fi
        done < "$f"
    fi
done

echo "$sum"
EOF
chmod +x solution.sh
./solution.sh
